BC_description: Internal methods of node-fetch are no longer exposed. Any code that imported and used undocumented internal methods will break. In v1.x, the user can access internal methods such as '_clone()', '_decode()', and '_convert()' on the 'response' object. In v2.x, these methods are completely inaccessible.
Adaptation_method: Remove all usages of undocumented/internal APIs from node-fetch/lib/*. Use only public, documented APIs exposed in the main 'node-fetch' module.
